By offering challenging and accelerated opportunities for growth, powered by a shared hunger for success, we create a space for your career to thrive. In return for your expertise, we are committed to providing competitive and robust total compensation and benefit packages to ensure you feel valued. Our dream is to become the fastest growing, most loved, window covering company in the world. What's yours? Position Overview The Director, FP& A – People Costs is a critical strategic partner to the CHRO, responsible for driving financial rigor, transparency, and forward-looking insights across all People Costs globally. This role will lead analysis, planning, forecasting, and process excellence for People Costs, while partnering closely with HR Zone Leaders, Finance, and Data & Analytics teams to ensure costs are well-managed, benchmarked, and aligned with business priorities. This is an early-career Director role, ideal for a high-performing Senior Manager ready to step into a broader enterprise-level leadership position with significant visibility and impact. Key Responsibilities 1. Monthly People Cost Performance & Forecasting (Primary Accountability) Lead the monthly analysis of People Costs across all zones, including actuals vs. budget, trend analysis, and forward-looking forecasts. Partner closely with HR Zone Leaders to: Identify drivers of performance and variances. Surface risks and opportunities to return to or beat plan. Diagnose top People Cost issues and facilitate structured problem-solving discussions. Ensure clear ownership of actions and follow-through. Leverage Zero-Based Organization (ZBO) analysis and external benchmarks to: Assess performance versus standards and peers. Identify structural cost opportunities and productivity improvements. Synthesize insights into clear, compelling executive-level narratives, not just reports.  2. Lead the Global People Cost Budget & Planning Process Own and lead the end-to-end People Cost budget process, delivering a high-quality consolidated plan to Global FP& A. Establish and maintain: Budgeting templates. Planning assumptions and guidance. Analytical frameworks to ensure consistency and comparability across zones. Partner with HR and Finance leaders in each zone to ensure: Timely submission of plans. High-quality, well-reasoned inputs. Clear articulation of levers to achieve or exceed plan. Analyze the consolidated plan to identify: Key risks and opportunities. Cost levers and trade-offs. Scenarios to support decision-making.  3. Build and Implement a Scalable People Cost Management Process Design and implement a standardized, end-to-end People Cost management process, integrating: Budgeting Monthly results Forecasting Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, and automate reporting and analysis. Partner cross-functionally with: Finance HR Zone Leaders Data Scientists / Analytics teams Drive adoption of new tools, dashboards, and ways of working that improve insight, speed, and decision quality.  4. Strategic Project Management (Approx. 25% of Role) Support the CHRO by project managing high-priority, non-People Cost initiatives, acting as a trusted thought partner and execution leader. Responsibilities may include: Structuring complex initiatives. Developing workplans, milestones, and tracking mechanisms. Driving cross-functional alignment and accountability. Preparing executive-level materials and updates. This aspect of the role provides exposure to enterprise-wide priorities and senior leadership.  Critical Capabilities & Skills Advanced data analytics and financial modeling skills, with the ability to translate data into insights. Strong problem-solving mindset; comfortable working through ambiguity and complexity. Exceptional communication and storytelling skills, particularly in executive presentations. Ability to influence without authority and work effectively across geographies and functions. High learning agility, ownership mindset, and bias for action. Comfortable operating at both strategic and detailed levels.  Experience & Profile 8–12 years of experience in FP& A, finance, strategy, or related analytical roles. Currently a Senior Manager or equivalent, ready for a first Director role. Experience partnering closely with senior leaders (HR or functional leadership exposure strongly preferred). Background in budgeting, forecasting, and performance management in a complex, multi-geography organization. Experience with ZBO, cost transformation, or productivity programs is a strong plus.  Why This Role High visibility and direct partnership with the CHRO. Opportunity to shape how People Costs are managed globally. Exposure to enterprise-level decision-making and transformation initiatives. Clear runway for growth and expanded leadership responsibility.  What's in it for you Generous benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life, disability A company culture that prioritizes transparency, entrepreneurship, accountability, meritocracy and one team Time off with pay 401(k) plan with a degree of employer matching Paid parental leave Wellness programs and product discounts  Please note, all offers presented to candidates are carefully crafted to ensure market competitiveness, equity, and reflect the individual candidate's education, experience, skills and potential. Hunter Douglas is an Equal Opportunity Employer and complies with applicable employment laws.

Hispanic market, Turkey, and Spain, among others. The company is headquartered in Miami, with offices across Mexico City, Bogotá, Buenos Aires, Istanbul, Bangalore, and São Paulo. We invite you to join us and be part of an innovative team dedicated to empowering our students. We are constantly seeking the best professionals in their fields to join our team. We offer the opportunity to work together and implement new ideas in a joyful and inspiring work environment. Position Overview We are looking for an Educational Project Service Leader who will play a key end-to-end role in the delivery of our educational projects, from implementation through renewal. As a key success driver within each initiative, and operating within our B2 G (Business to Government) structure, this role is responsible for the day-to-day leadership, execution, and performance of assigned projects. You will be accountable for ensuring that each project meets its defined objectives and KPIs, proactively designing and executing strategies to drive performance, adoption, and partner satisfaction. In close collaboration with the Customer Service team, you will lead initiatives that enhance student engagement and deliver an exceptional service experience. As the main operational point of contact for partners, you will lead project execution, align cross-functional teams, anticipate risks, and identify opportunities for growth and renewal. Success in this role requires a strong balance of project ownership, stakeholder management, and data-driven decision-making. This role also requires availability for occasional national and international travel to strengthen partner relationships and support the execution of key initiatives. Project Ownership & Execution: Own the end-to-end execution and performance of assigned educational projects, ensuring successful implementation, delivery, and renewal. Drive day-to-day operations, track progress against milestones, and proactively address risks and blockers. Partner Collaboration & Stakeholder Alignment: Work closely with the account owner and key partner stakeholders to ensure alignment on project goals, expectations, and performance. Support partner interactions by providing operational insights, updates, and solutions that strengthen the overall relationship. Performance Management & Strategy: Own project performance against defined KPIs, continuously monitoring results and identifying gaps. Design and execute data-driven strategies to improve adoption, engagement, and overall project outcomes. Student Engagement & Service Excellence: Partner closely with the Customer Service team to develop and implement initiatives that enhance student engagement and ensure a high-quality, consistent service experience. Cross-Functional Leadership: Lead coordination across internal teams (Product, Operations, Content, Legal, etc.) to ensure alignment, timely execution, and successful delivery of project requirements and new initiatives. Process Optimization & Scalability: Continuously evaluate and improve workflows, tools, and processes to increase efficiency, scalability, and quality in project execution. Risk Management & Continuous Improvement: Anticipate potential challenges, identify root causes of issues, and implement proactive solutions. Drive continuous improvement initiatives based on insights, feedback, and performance trends. Reporting & Insights: Track, analyze, and report on key performance metrics, providing actionable insights to the account owner, partner stakeholders, and internal leadership to inform decision-making and strategy adjustments. Must-Have Skills & Qualifications Project management experience: Proven track record managing end-to-end project execution, including timelines, delivery, and milestones. KPI & performance ownership: Experience tracking and delivering results against KPIs, using data to drive decisions and improvements. Stakeholder & cross-functional collaboration: Experience working with multiple internal teams and supporting external stakeholders in coordination with an account owner or manager. Global & cross-cultural collaboration: Experience working in multicultural environments, with the ability to collaborate effectively across regions, cultures, and time zones. Customer/student engagement focus: Experience driving adoption, engagement, or satisfaction in service-based or educational environments. Analytical & problem-solving skills: Ability to identify performance gaps and implement effective, data-driven solutions. Strong communication skills: Ability to clearly convey updates, insights, and recommendations to different audiences. Operational & process improvement mindset: Experience optimizing workflows and improving execution efficiency. Tech proficiency: Experience with CRM, project management, and reporting tools (e. G., Salesforce, Zendesk, Asana, Excel/Sheets). English proficiency (B2 or higher) Availability to travel  Preferred Experience Experience in B2 G or public sector projects: Exposure to working with government entities, public institutions, or large-scale educational programs. Background in Ed Tech or education programs: Experience managing or supporting educational initiatives, digital learning platforms, or student-focused services. Experience in scalable or multi-project environments: Familiarity working in environments where multiple projects run simultaneously under shared structures or leadership. Advanced data analysis & reporting: Experience using dashboards, BI tools (e. G., Tableau, Power BI), or advanced Excel/Sheets to generate insights and drive decisions. Process design & standardization: Experience building or standardizing processes that can be replicated across projects or teams. Indirect leadership experience: Experience mentoring, coaching, or influencing team members without direct reporting lines. Experience working in global organizations: Exposure to distributed teams, regional coordination, or international project environments.

Your Future, Fuelled by Innovation The Global Compliance Lead, Bioenergy Assurance is responsible for the effective execution of Nufarm's global Assurance Program and related compliance systems. The role leads global certification and audit direction, works closely with regional teams to achieve and maintain 100% certification readiness and compliance, and broadens program oversight beyond certification to include legal, environmental, social, traceability, and internal policy requirements. This position also oversees internal assessment of centrally managed global processes - including GHG tool governance, methodology determination, risk management, and related controls - to identify gaps, drive corrective actions, and strengthen end-to-end assurance performance across the business. How You'll Help Us Grow Lead global certification and audit direction across the Assurance Program, including coordination with certification bodies, auditors, and regional teams. Monitor and collaborate with relevant global certification schemes to maintain Nufarm's leadership and competitive position. Own interpretation and implementation guidance for certification requirements, standards, procedures, and related external scheme updates. Drive certification readiness and performance across regions to achieve and maintain 100% certification compliance. Oversee certification program deployment and implementation for new countries, processors, value chain partners, and applicable carbon-credit or market requirements. Support and provide oversight across the internal audit program(s) for regional assurance activities, ensuring audits are completed well, correctly, and comprehensively. This role is not responsible for regional program implementation. Conduct internal assessment or audit of centrally managed global processes owned by the global team, potentially including GHG tool modelling and development, methodology determination, documentation controls, and risk management processes. Identify control gaps, process weaknesses, and compliance risks across legal, environmental, social, and internal requirements. Verify that centrally managed processes are documented, version-controlled, implemented consistently, and supported by appropriate evidence. Facilitate or oversee risk identification, risk assessment, risk management, and risk monitoring activities required under the Assurance Program and associated standards. Contribute to updates to global certification documentation, audit tools, SOPs, work instructions, and related compliance materials. Partner with program management, data/IT, and regional teams to strengthen systems, reporting, and process design for ongoing program improvement. Review regional audit outputs, supporting evidence, and corrective action plans; escalate and ensure closure of significant non-compliances as appropriate. Monitor regional execution of land use verification, traceability, mass balance, UDB-related direction, training, and documentation expectations. Assess regional capability and provide coaching, training, and tools to improve audit quality and consistency. Build trusted working relationships across regions and functions to align expectations, remove barriers, and reinforce accountability. Provide leadership, mentoring, and development for any direct reports and strong matrix leadership for regional assurance personnel. Support training, communication, and change management efforts related to certification, compliance, and assurance.  If you want to be a part of a thriving, supportive environment and are inspired by the prospect of being a part of something bigger, we'd love to hear from you. Nufarm is proud to be recognised as an endorsed top 10 employer of choice for all women by WORK180. A note to recruitment agencies - we have this role covered. title: Senior backend engineer (golang)
description:
Empresa está contratando Senior backend engineer (golang) em atibaia. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

OPEN TO ALL CANDIDATES ACROSS LATIN AMERICA  Title:  Senior Backend Engineer (Golang) – Data Infrastructure & Recommendations  Company:  Fulcrum Saa S  Location:  Remote – Latin America (strong overlap with Americas time zones required) Type:  Full-time  Level:  Senior / Staff  Compensation:  USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location  About Fulcrum Saa S   Fulcrum Saa S is a conversion rate optimization (CRO) platform that powers product recommendations for ecommerce brands. Our infrastructure processes high-volume behavioral events, feeds real-time recommendation algorithms, and serves personalized experiences at scale. We operate in a multi-tenant Saa S environment where data correctness, low latency, and system reliability are non-negotiable.  Our stack includes Go, Bigtable, Big Query, Pub/Sub, and a dual-store architecture (operational + analytical) that we designed from scratch.  The Role   We are looking for a senior backend engineer who has built and operated production data systems under real load—not prototypes, not internal tools. This is a core infrastructure role at the intersection of our operational and analytical data layers.  You will own the systems that move behavioral event data from ingestion through transformation into our recommendation engine. You will design for correctness, build for observability, and make architectural tradeoffs with the pragmatism that only comes from production scars.  You will be an early engineering hire with real influence over our technical direction.  What You’ll Do   Design and operate high-throughput event ingestion pipelines capable of processing millions of events per day with low-latency serving requirements.  Own the dual-store architecture that separates our operational (real-time) and analytical (batch) data layers, including streaming vs. batch pipeline design and failure recovery.  Build and maintain data movement infrastructure between stores (Bigtable/Big Query or comparable), ensuring consistency, at-least-once delivery, and graceful degradation.  Instrument production systems: define SLOs, implement distributed tracing, and build alerting that distinguishes signal from noise.  Partner with the recommendation team to evolve our scoring, waterfall, and ranking infrastructure.  Drive architectural decisions on data modeling, schema evolution, and multi-tenant isolation.  Participate in an on-call rotation and own incidents end-to-end—from detection through root cause analysis to postmortem.    What We’re Looking For (Must-Haves)  5–10+ years of hands-on backend engineering in production environments (more is better).  Track record of building and operating high-performance, high-throughput, low-latency systems at scale—not just prototypes.  Deep working knowledge of Go’s concurrency model (goroutines, channels, context, sync primitives)—beyond syntax familiarity.  Experience with columnar or wide-column stores: Bigtable/Big Query strongly preferred; Cassandra, Dynamo DB, Redshift, or Snowflake are comparable.  Hands-on experience moving data between operational and analytical stores—you have solved streaming vs. batch tradeoffs, handled delivery guarantees, and recovered from pipeline failures.  Experience with production observability: metrics, tracing, alerting, dashboards—you know what good instrumentation looks like.  Multi-tenant Saa S experience—you understand isolation, scaling, and noisy-neighbor challenges when serving multiple customers on shared infrastructure.  Batch pipeline design experience—you know when batch is the right tool and how to make it reliable.  Dual-store architecture experience—you have operated systems where the operational and analytical data layers are intentionally separate.  Comfortable working daily in English with a US-based team (meetings, async communication, code reviews, and technical documentation).    Strong Nice-to-Haves   Identity resolution and cross-device stitching (probabilistic or deterministic).  A/B testing infrastructure built for statistical rigor—not just feature flags, but impression tracking, experiment analysis, and statistical significance frameworks.  Recommendation systems experience: scoring heuristics, waterfall algorithms, collaborative filtering, or hybrid approaches.  Ecommerce domain knowledge: attribution models, conversion tracking, order/cart data models, session stitching.    What We Offer   Compensation in the range of USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location, benchmarked to senior remote engineering roles in LATAM.  Remote-first culture with async-friendly practices.  Direct access to leadership; your architectural opinions will be heard and implemented.  A team that treats production reliability as a first-class engineering concern.    How to Apply   Please apply through Linked In with your CV (English) and a brief note highlighting:  Your experience with Go in production.  The most demanding data/throughput system you have owned.  Your country of residence and preferred start date.    You can also include links to Git Hub, technical blogs, or talks if available.

title: Operations director
description:
Empresa está contratando Operations director em flores da cunha. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Kinetic Homes - Operations Director  Introduction:   Kinetic Homes is a homebuilder based in Jacksonville FL focused on expanding homeownership by constructing high quality, affordable homes in vibrant neighborhoods. The business was founded by Erik Nordahl and has built & sold over 100 homes over the past 3 years.  This role will be an early hire in a rapidly growing organization. The individual for this role will report directly to the founder, Erik Nordahl. Mentorship and professional development are critical to Erik, and he will seek to assist his colleagues in their professional development and share the learnings he has accumulated throughout his career. This individual will have opportunity to eventually manage a team of individual contributors in the future.  Compensation:   $40,000-90,000 USD per year.    Duties & Responsibilities:   Permitting  Ensure all necessary permits are obtained for new construction projects.  Complete and submit permit applications for new construction.  Assist with septic permits and HOA applications.  Address permit application rejections in a timely manner.  Facilitate communication between surveyors, architects, engineers, etc. via email and phone.  Regularly call and email vendors and city officials to ensure timely deliverables.  Maintain database to ensure files are updated with all necessary documentation.  Maintain a knowledge of and be prepared to answer questions about the status of permits for all new construction.    Development Support  Prepare permit packages to be sent to our field development team.  File required documentation through online portals to be recorded with the appropriate county.    Procurement  Regularly solicit updated pricing among vendors to ensure we are obtaining competitive pricing.  Request purchase orders for active jobs that are under construction.  Check invoices from vendors to ensure that invoiced amounts match master pricing agreements.    Transaction Support  Prepare drafts of Purchase & Sale contracts.  Assist team in due diligence process coordination for all transactions.  Maintain closing calendars for transactions to ensure team is aware of key deadlines and terms.    Qualifications:   University degree. Four or more years of successful experience in a professional work environment  Strong skills in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel) and Adobe PDF.  Interest and use of latest AI technology products is key. Interest and curiosity in how to streamline operations through AI and technology is viewed positively.  Possess strong verbal and written English skills.  Must be highly organized and attentive to detail.  Willing to work in high-pressure environment.  Willing to be responsive and communicative.  Availability is key. Candidate must be willing to respond to time-sensitive requests outside of normal working hours. Normal working hours are 9 AM to 5 PM EST.  The team member may occasionally be asked to work weekends, but that is abnormal.  Good attitude necessary.

Kinetic Homes - Operations Director  Introduction:   Kinetic Homes is a homebuilder based in Jacksonville FL focused on expanding homeownership by constructing high quality, affordable homes in vibrant neighborhoods. Assist with septic permits and HOA applications.  Address permit application rejections in a timely manner. Development Support  Prepare permit packages to be sent to our field development team.  File required documentation through online portals to be recorded with the appropriate county.    Procurement  Regularly solicit updated pricing among vendors to ensure we are obtaining competitive pricing.  Request purchase orders for active jobs that are under construction.  Check invoices from vendors to ensure that invoiced amounts match master pricing agreements.    Transaction Support  Prepare drafts of Purchase & Sale contracts.  Assist team in due diligence process coordination for all transactions.  Maintain closing calendars for transactions to ensure team is aware of key deadlines and terms. Availability is key. Candidate must be willing to respond to time-sensitive requests outside of normal working hours. Normal working hours are 9 AM to 5 PM EST.  The team member may occasionally be asked to work weekends, but that is abnormal.  Good attitude necessary.

title: Senior backend engineer (golang)
description:
Empresa está contratando Senior backend engineer (golang) em jaguariúna. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

OPEN TO ALL CANDIDATES ACROSS LATIN AMERICA  Title:  Senior Backend Engineer (Golang) – Data Infrastructure & Recommendations  Company:  Fulcrum Saa S  Location:  Remote – Latin America (strong overlap with Americas time zones required) Type:  Full-time  Level:  Senior / Staff  Compensation:  USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location  About Fulcrum Saa S   Fulcrum Saa S is a conversion rate optimization (CRO) platform that powers product recommendations for ecommerce brands. Our infrastructure processes high-volume behavioral events, feeds real-time recommendation algorithms, and serves personalized experiences at scale. We operate in a multi-tenant Saa S environment where data correctness, low latency, and system reliability are non-negotiable.  Our stack includes Go, Bigtable, Big Query, Pub/Sub, and a dual-store architecture (operational + analytical) that we designed from scratch.  The Role   We are looking for a senior backend engineer who has built and operated production data systems under real load—not prototypes, not internal tools. This is a core infrastructure role at the intersection of our operational and analytical data layers.  You will own the systems that move behavioral event data from ingestion through transformation into our recommendation engine. You will design for correctness, build for observability, and make architectural tradeoffs with the pragmatism that only comes from production scars.  You will be an early engineering hire with real influence over our technical direction.  What You’ll Do   Design and operate high-throughput event ingestion pipelines capable of processing millions of events per day with low-latency serving requirements.  Own the dual-store architecture that separates our operational (real-time) and analytical (batch) data layers, including streaming vs. batch pipeline design and failure recovery.  Build and maintain data movement infrastructure between stores (Bigtable/Big Query or comparable), ensuring consistency, at-least-once delivery, and graceful degradation.  Instrument production systems: define SLOs, implement distributed tracing, and build alerting that distinguishes signal from noise.  Partner with the recommendation team to evolve our scoring, waterfall, and ranking infrastructure.  Drive architectural decisions on data modeling, schema evolution, and multi-tenant isolation.  Participate in an on-call rotation and own incidents end-to-end—from detection through root cause analysis to postmortem.    What We’re Looking For (Must-Haves)  5–10+ years of hands-on backend engineering in production environments (more is better).  Track record of building and operating high-performance, high-throughput, low-latency systems at scale—not just prototypes.  Deep working knowledge of Go’s concurrency model (goroutines, channels, context, sync primitives)—beyond syntax familiarity.  Experience with columnar or wide-column stores: Bigtable/Big Query strongly preferred; Cassandra, Dynamo DB, Redshift, or Snowflake are comparable.  Hands-on experience moving data between operational and analytical stores—you have solved streaming vs. batch tradeoffs, handled delivery guarantees, and recovered from pipeline failures.  Experience with production observability: metrics, tracing, alerting, dashboards—you know what good instrumentation looks like.  Multi-tenant Saa S experience—you understand isolation, scaling, and noisy-neighbor challenges when serving multiple customers on shared infrastructure.  Batch pipeline design experience—you know when batch is the right tool and how to make it reliable.  Dual-store architecture experience—you have operated systems where the operational and analytical data layers are intentionally separate.  Comfortable working daily in English with a US-based team (meetings, async communication, code reviews, and technical documentation).    Strong Nice-to-Haves   Identity resolution and cross-device stitching (probabilistic or deterministic).  A/B testing infrastructure built for statistical rigor—not just feature flags, but impression tracking, experiment analysis, and statistical significance frameworks.  Recommendation systems experience: scoring heuristics, waterfall algorithms, collaborative filtering, or hybrid approaches.  Ecommerce domain knowledge: attribution models, conversion tracking, order/cart data models, session stitching.    What We Offer   Compensation in the range of USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location, benchmarked to senior remote engineering roles in LATAM.  Remote-first culture with async-friendly practices.  Direct access to leadership; your architectural opinions will be heard and implemented.  A team that treats production reliability as a first-class engineering concern.    How to Apply   Please apply through Linked In with your CV (English) and a brief note highlighting:  Your experience with Go in production.  The most demanding data/throughput system you have owned.  Your country of residence and preferred start date.    You can also include links to Git Hub, technical blogs, or talks if available.

description:

Do you enjoy working inside systems, fixing what’s broken, and making things run correctly?  Can you take messy, inconsistent data and turn it into something accurate, reliable, and usable?   Do you get satisfaction from building workflows, troubleshooting issues, and ensuring nothing slips through the cracks?   Final question:  When faced with a complex challenge, do you get excited, or run away?  At Crisp, we’re on a mission to help 10,000 law firms each grow their revenue by $10,000,000 over the next 10 years, creating a $10 billion impact in the legal industry.  We operate with the intensity of a championship team, where every player is expected to bring their best, own their outcomes, and drive results.  We’re hiring a Hub Spot Sales Data Operations team member to support our Sales organization by owning data accuracy, workflow execution, and system reliability inside Hub Spot.  This role exists for one reason:  …to ensure that our Hub Spot data is accurate, our sales workflows function correctly, and our Sales team can operate without friction, enabling leadership to make decisions based on reliable data and drive revenue growth. If data is wrong, decisions are wrong. This role ensures that never happens.  ** IMPORTANT: TO APPLY **   You will be evaluated and vetted based on your ability to follow instructions:    Follow this  Willo link  (recorded interview platform), and answer the few questions on there, first. Then reply to the ad, stating you’ve completed the Willo, and we will be in touch.     Who You Are:    You are highly detail-oriented and process-driven.  You take ownership of problems and solve them without being handheld.  You move with urgency and do not let tasks sit idle.  You are highly experienced being the Hub Spot expert and troubleshooting issues independently.  You are not afraid to “get your hands dirty” fixing data and cleaning systems.  You communicate clearly and directly.  You can handle a fast-paced, high-pressure environment with strong personalities.  You do not make excuses, rather, you find solutions.    What You’ll Do:    Hub Spot Data Ownership & Accuracy   Own data cleanliness and accuracy inside Hub Spot across the entire sales pipeline  Identify and fix incorrect, incomplete, or inconsistent data  Ensure all sales data reflects reality and can be trusted for decision-making    Workflow & Automation Execution   Build, maintain, and troubleshoot Hub Spot workflows and automations  Ensure lead routing, deal movement, and task assignments function correctly  Reduce friction for Sales by simplifying and optimizing workflows    Sales Pipeline & Reporting Support   Maintain and support the integrity of the deal pipeline (lead → calls → close) Ensure accurate tracking of sales KPIs and performance metrics  Support and maintain integrations feeding into reporting systems (e.g., “Daily Dash”)   System Troubleshooting & Problem Solving   Diagnose issues across Hub Spot, integrations, and workflows  Work cross-functionally with Sales team members to identify root causes  Implement solutions quickly without waiting for direction    Process Documentation & Training   Build and maintain clear, step-by-step process documentation (“point-and-click” SOPs) Train Sales team members on correct system usage  Ensure new hires are properly set up and onboarded in Hub Spot and related tools    Quality Control & System Integrity   Ensure all workflows, automations, and data structures are functioning correctly  Continuously monitor for errors, inconsistencies, and breakdowns  Escalate issues quickly and proactively    Our Requirements Are Pretty Straightforward. To Qualify You Must:   2+ years experience managing a company’s Hub Spot instance for Sales  Strong understanding of sales pipelines and funnel stages  Proven experience building workflows and automations  Strong problem-solving ability and resourcefulness  High level of proficiency in Google Sheets (formulas, lookups, data handling) Ability to work independently and execute without constant direction  Strong written and spoken English  Ability to work U. S. business hours consistently  Ability to move quickly without sacrificing accuracy  Bonus:  Hub Spot certifications  Experience with the following integrations: Zapier, Coefficient  Familiarity with sales tools such as Zoom Phone or similar systems  Exposure to AI tools or automation platforms    In Return, Here’s Our Promise to You:    At Crisp, we don’t just hire people: we build A-players.  Clear expectations. You will know exactly what success looks like.  High-impact work. Your work directly affects revenue decisions.  Fast-paced environment. Work moves quickly and decisively.  Growth opportunity. Strong performance leads to expanded responsibility.  Ownership culture. You are trusted to solve problems and execute.    Why Our Work Matters:    Lawyers go to law school to learn how to practice law, but law school doesn’t teach them how to run a business. In a world where the best cases often go to the best marketers, not necessarily the best lawyers, legal expertise alone isn’t enough. That’s where Crisp comes in.  We partner with committed, growth-minded law firms that care deeply about their teams, clients, and communities. Often, it’s a David vs. Goliath scenario, where the most dedicated attorneys lack the resources of their larger competitors.  Our mission is to level the playing field, equipping these firms with the tools, strategies, and support they need to stand out and win.  We empower law firms to not only grow their businesses but also make a bigger impact — delivering better outcomes and driving positive change.  At Crisp, we’re here to ensure that the best law firms, no matter their size, have a fighting chance to lead, serve, and transform their communities.  By empowering our law firm clients to succeed, we’re not just building stronger businesses; we’re creating a ripple effect of positive change that impacts lives, families, and communities across the country.  About Crisp:    Crisp is an incredibly fast-moving, high-growth company (1470%+ growth in 3 years) with a laser focus on delivering the absolute best legal marketing and business coaching services on the market today.  Check out what we are about here:  We’re all about working hard and staying humble. In the spirit of humble bragging, here are some of our awards and accolades:  Crisp Founder and CEO Michael Mogill named EY Entrepreneur Of The Year® 2023 Named to Inc. 5000 List of Fastest-Growing Private Companies for 7-Years (2024, 2022, 2021, 2020, 2019, 2018, 2017) Atlanta’s fastest-growing companies 9 years in a row (2024, 2023, 2022, 2021, 2020, 2019, 2018, 2017, 2016) Recognized as Atlanta’s Best Places to Work  Creators and annual hosts of the Crisp Game Changers Summit , the largest and most ambitious law firm growth conference on Earth  Published the legal industry’s best-selling marketing book  Host of the most listened-to podcast in the legal industry  Featured in Forbes, The Wall Street Journal, Tech Crunch, Yahoo, and The Huffington Post    Why You Should Work Here:   You will work in a company where operations and systems are taken seriously  You will be part of building and improving core sales infrastructure  You will gain exposure to high-level sales operations and systems  You will be pushed to grow and perform at a high level    If you’re looking for a job that’s boring and easy, you won’t find that here. We put 110% into everything we do. Greatness is achieved through hard work, discipline, and sacrifice, and we’re determined to be great.  If you want to solve real problems, own systems, and operate at a high level — apply.

title: Finance manager
description:
Confira a vaga para Finance manager em remote. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Finance Manager  Location: Fully Remote (LATAM)   Job Type: Full-Time   Strong financial operations don’t just track performance, they drive it.  We’re looking for a Finance Manager who can take ownership of our accounting and financial processes, improve reporting speed and accuracy, and support operational decision-making as we scale.  About Uproot Clean   Uproot Clean is a fast-growing, performance-driven consumer brand built for pet owners. We operate across ecommerce and retail, and our finance function plays a critical role in enabling smart, data-driven growth.  We believe finance should be proactive, structured, and tightly connected to operations. That’s where you come in.  The Role   This is an ownership role. You will manage the full accounting cycle, oversee financial reporting, and ensure accuracy across all financial operations.  You will work closely with the VP of Operations and play a key role in improving processes, shortening close cycles, and building a scalable finance function.  This is not a purely back-office role, you’ll be expected to think analytically, identify inefficiencies, and actively improve how we operate.  This Role Is For You If:   You think in systems and processes, not just tasks  You are detail-oriented and highly organized  You are comfortable owning the full accounting cycle  You enjoy improving workflows and increasing efficiency  You can balance accuracy with speed in a fast-paced environment    This Role Is NOT For You If:   You prefer narrowly defined tasks without ownership  You struggle with deadlines or process improvement  You are not comfortable working in a high-growth environment    What You'll Do   Accounting & Financial Operations   Own the full accounting cycle, including month-end close  Prepare financial statements and reports  Ensure accuracy and compliance across financial records    Month-End Close & Process Improvement   Reduce month-end close timeline from 5 days to 3 days  Identify inefficiencies and improve accounting workflows  Build scalable processes and documentation    Team Oversight   Manage and oversee the bookkeeping team and AP clerk  Ensure quality, accuracy, and timeliness of work    Cost & Inventory Accounting   Manage and apply landed costs across products  Ensure accurate cost tracking and margin visibility    Reporting & Analysis   Provide financial insights and analysis to support decision-making  Work closely with the VP of Operations on performance tracking    Requirements   Must have:   1+ year  of experience in ecommerce or DTC   Experience  managing full accounting cycle and financial reporting   Strong  understanding of accounting principles   Strong  analytical and problem-solving skills  High  attention to detail and organization    Work Requirements   ⏰  Schedule:  Flexble   Workspace:  Fixed, professional setup required (stable internet + backup plan)  Benefits & Compensation    Fully remote    Paid time off    Flex days.  Enjoy an extra quarterly day off to unwind and recharge energies whenever you desire  Ownership & autonomy  - trusted to build and execute strategy    Ready to Apply?   If you want to build and scale a high-performing finance function, apply now.

title: Engenheiro de dados sênior
description:
Nova oportunidade para Engenheiro de dados sênior em remote. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Sobre a Volpi  Somos uma fintech em crescimento acelerado que está protagonizando a  evolução do financiamento imobiliário  . Transformamos processos tradicionalmente burocráticos, caros e ineficientes em experiências  inteligentes, simples e digitais  . Se você acredita que tecnologia pode mudar a vida das pessoas - e quer fazer parte de uma equipe que vive isso na prática - vem com a gente! O desafio   Buscamos um  Senior Data Engineer  para liderar a construção da engenharia de dados da Volpi desde a base.  Hoje, nossos dados estão distribuídos em múltiplas fontes, com diferentes níveis de maturidade. Seu papel será estruturar essa fundação: definir a arquitetura, organizar os dados, criar pipelines confiáveis e habilitar a criação de produtos de dados que apoiem decisões críticas de negócio.  Aqui, você terá  alto nível de autonomia e ownership  , tomando decisões técnicas que vão sustentar o crescimento da empresa nos próximos anos.  O que você vai fazer:    Desenhar, implementar e evoluir a  arquitetura de dados da Volpi  , com foco em um modelo de  lakehouse  na AWS;   Estruturar pipelines de ingestão, transformação e consumo de dados (batch e, futuramente, streaming);  Trabalhar com dados sensíveis de crédito e pessoas, seguindo padrões rigorosos de  segurança, governança e compliance  ;   Lidar com  dados distribuídos em múltiplos silos  , conectando fontes e criando visões mais maduras para o negócio;   Atender demandas estratégicas de diferentes áreas (crédito, operações, produto, engenharia);  Organizar e evoluir o data lake existente (já temos estrutura inicial em AWS, Athena e S3);  Criar a base para  produtos de dados futuros  , incluindo análises avançadas de crédito e soluções orientadas a dados;   Atuar de forma full-cycle, da concepção técnica à implementação, operação e evolução em produção.    O que esperamos de você:    Experiência sólida como  Data Engineer  , com forte mentalidade de engenharia (Data Engineer aqui é dev);   Domínio de Python e SQL  para construção de pipelines e soluções de dados em produção;   Experiência prática com  AWS  , especialmente serviços como S3, Athena e IAM;   Conhecimento e uso de  Infraestrutura como Código (Ia C) ;   Vivência com pipelines de dados em produção, lidando com volumes relevantes e dados sensíveis;  Forte preocupação com  segurança da informação  , padrões de projeto e boas práticas de engenharia;   Experiência em  ambientes de startup  , lidando com pouco legado e muita construção do zero;   Autonomia para tomar decisões técnicas e conduzir projetos end-to-end;  Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções de dados escaláveis;  Comunicação clara e estruturada, especialmente em ambientes assíncronos.    Será considerado um diferencial:   Experiência com arquiteturas de dados modernas, como lakehouse;  Uso de ferramentas de orquestração e transformação de dados (ex: Airflow, dbt ou similares);  Atuação em domínios complexos e regulados, como financeiro, crédito ou seguros;  Vivência na construção e estruturação de plataformas ou áreas de dados desde o início.    Benefícios que oferecemos:   Modelo remoto prioritário  Plano de saúde Alice (100% pago para titular e dependentes) R$600/ano para infraestrutura de home office  R$1.000/ano de auxílio educação  30 dias de descanso remunerado + 10 dias de recesso de fim de ano  Day off no aniversário  Total Pass (incluindo Total Mind) Acesso ao Wework  Encontros presenciais para troca e conexão com a nossa Tribo

title: Estágio de direito - home office
description:
Nova oportunidade para Estágio de direito - home office em remote. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

O escritório  Ulisses Carneiro Advogados  ( especializado em  Direito Previdenciário (RGPS) , com sede em Brasília e atuação em todo o território nacional, está com vaga aberta para  Estágio em Direito  (6º ao 9º semestre), com atuação 100% home office  . Sobre o Escritório  Com mais de 17 anos de experiência  e 50 mil clientes atendidos em todo o Brasil  , o escritório Ulisses Carneiro Advogados se consolidou como referência em Direito Previdenciário.  Somos também pioneiros no uso de tecnologia na advocacia: contamos com o  ADV Space  , nosso próprio software jurídico integrado com inteligência artificial, criado para otimizar atendimentos e transformar a experiência do cliente.  Nosso fundador, Bruno Ulisses Carneiro, começou a programar em 1998, aos 14 anos, e desde então une Direito e tecnologia para criar soluções inovadoras. Além de advogado, Bruno é professor do  Instituto Professora Melissa Folmann  , onde já formou centenas de advogados e mentorou profissionais que hoje lideram seus próprios escritórios.  Aqui, o estágio não é apenas cumprir horas: é uma oportunidade de  aprender na prática  com quem já formou talentos e continua transformando a advocacia com inovação.  Detalhes da Vaga  Horário:  9h às 15h (6 horas diárias)  Bolsa:  R$ 1.200,00 + ajuda de custo para home office   Modelo:  100% remoto (aceitamos candidatos de qualquer localidade) Início:  imediato, após formalização do contrato pelo IEL    ✅ O que esperamos de você  Estar cursando entre o 6º e o 9º semestre de Direito  .   Ter  vivência prática em Direito Previdenciário  (estágio anterior, núcleo de prática ou projetos reais).   Boa comunicação escrita e/ou oral (recepção de clientes, análise de casos, auxílio em conversão de contratos).  Comprometimento, organização e vontade de crescer.    O que oferecemos  Atuação prática em casos reais  de Direito Previdenciário.   Contato direto com clientes via ADV Space.  Possibilidade de desenvolver tanto a parte  técnica (petições, análise de documentos) quanto a parte  comercial (conversão de contratos, relacionamento com clientes) .   Cultura de inovação, uso de tecnologia e espaço para crescimento.  Orientação direta com um escritório que já formou diversos profissionais hoje líderes no mercado.    Processo Seletivo  Formulário online  (Google Forms – necessário login com Gmail):    Prova escrita narrativa  (online).  Entrevista final  com o fundador.    A vaga ficará aberta até 20/05/2026 .  Os selecionados receberão comunicação oficial pelo e-mail     (verifique também sua caixa de spam).  Observações  O candidato não precisa ter OAB.  O contrato será formalizado pelo  IEL  (auxiliaremos no cadastro, se necessário).   O contato com o escritório deve ser feito  exclusivamente por e-mail  . Mensagens via Whats App ou ligações resultarão em desclassificação.

title: Business strategy consultant
description:

Organizations collect mountains of data about their customers — and still struggle to act on it. Power BI, Tableau, or other BI tools.  Experience with customer analytics, Voice of Customer programs, or customer journey analysis.

OPEN TO ALL CANDIDATES ACROSS LATIN AMERICA  Title:  Senior Backend Engineer (Golang) – Data Infrastructure & Recommendations  Company:  Fulcrum Saa S  Location:  Remote – Latin America (strong overlap with Americas time zones required) Type:  Full-time  Level:  Senior / Staff  Compensation:  USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location  About Fulcrum Saa S   Fulcrum Saa S is a conversion rate optimization (CRO) platform that powers product recommendations for ecommerce brands. Our infrastructure processes high-volume behavioral events, feeds real-time recommendation algorithms, and serves personalized experiences at scale. We operate in a multi-tenant Saa S environment where data correctness, low latency, and system reliability are non-negotiable.  Our stack includes Go, Bigtable, Big Query, Pub/Sub, and a dual-store architecture (operational + analytical) that we designed from scratch.  The Role   We are looking for a senior backend engineer who has built and operated production data systems under real load—not prototypes, not internal tools. This is a core infrastructure role at the intersection of our operational and analytical data layers.  You will own the systems that move behavioral event data from ingestion through transformation into our recommendation engine. You will design for correctness, build for observability, and make architectural tradeoffs with the pragmatism that only comes from production scars.  You will be an early engineering hire with real influence over our technical direction.  What You’ll Do   Design and operate high-throughput event ingestion pipelines capable of processing millions of events per day with low-latency serving requirements.  Own the dual-store architecture that separates our operational (real-time) and analytical (batch) data layers, including streaming vs. batch pipeline design and failure recovery.  Build and maintain data movement infrastructure between stores (Bigtable/Big Query or comparable), ensuring consistency, at-least-once delivery, and graceful degradation.  Instrument production systems: define SLOs, implement distributed tracing, and build alerting that distinguishes signal from noise.  Partner with the recommendation team to evolve our scoring, waterfall, and ranking infrastructure.  Drive architectural decisions on data modeling, schema evolution, and multi-tenant isolation.  Participate in an on-call rotation and own incidents end-to-end—from detection through root cause analysis to postmortem.    What We’re Looking For (Must-Haves)  5–10+ years of hands-on backend engineering in production environments (more is better).  Track record of building and operating high-performance, high-throughput, low-latency systems at scale—not just prototypes.  Deep working knowledge of Go’s concurrency model (goroutines, channels, context, sync primitives)—beyond syntax familiarity.  Experience with columnar or wide-column stores: Bigtable/Big Query strongly preferred; Cassandra, Dynamo DB, Redshift, or Snowflake are comparable.  Hands-on experience moving data between operational and analytical stores—you have solved streaming vs. batch tradeoffs, handled delivery guarantees, and recovered from pipeline failures.  Experience with production observability: metrics, tracing, alerting, dashboards—you know what good instrumentation looks like.  Multi-tenant Saa S experience—you understand isolation, scaling, and noisy-neighbor challenges when serving multiple customers on shared infrastructure.  Batch pipeline design experience—you know when batch is the right tool and how to make it reliable.  Dual-store architecture experience—you have operated systems where the operational and analytical data layers are intentionally separate.  Comfortable working daily in English with a US-based team (meetings, async communication, code reviews, and technical documentation).    Strong Nice-to-Haves   Identity resolution and cross-device stitching (probabilistic or deterministic).  A/B testing infrastructure built for statistical rigor—not just feature flags, but impression tracking, experiment analysis, and statistical significance frameworks.  Recommendation systems experience: scoring heuristics, waterfall algorithms, collaborative filtering, or hybrid approaches.  Ecommerce domain knowledge: attribution models, conversion tracking, order/cart data models, session stitching.    What We Offer   Compensation in the range of USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location, benchmarked to senior remote engineering roles in LATAM.  Remote-first culture with async-friendly practices.  Direct access to leadership; your architectural opinions will be heard and implemented.  A team that treats production reliability as a first-class engineering concern.    How to Apply   Please apply through Linked In with your CV (English) and a brief note highlighting:  Your experience with Go in production.  The most demanding data/throughput system you have owned.  Your country of residence and preferred start date.    You can also include links to Git Hub, technical blogs, or talks if available.

OPEN TO ALL CANDIDATES ACROSS LATIN AMERICA  Title:  Senior Backend Engineer (Golang) – Data Infrastructure & Recommendations  Company:  Fulcrum Saa S  Location:  Remote – Latin America (strong overlap with Americas time zones required) Type:  Full-time  Level:  Senior / Staff  Compensation:  USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location  About Fulcrum Saa S   Fulcrum Saa S is a conversion rate optimization (CRO) platform that powers product recommendations for ecommerce brands. Our infrastructure processes high-volume behavioral events, feeds real-time recommendation algorithms, and serves personalized experiences at scale. We operate in a multi-tenant Saa S environment where data correctness, low latency, and system reliability are non-negotiable.  Our stack includes Go, Bigtable, Big Query, Pub/Sub, and a dual-store architecture (operational + analytical) that we designed from scratch.  The Role   We are looking for a senior backend engineer who has built and operated production data systems under real load—not prototypes, not internal tools. This is a core infrastructure role at the intersection of our operational and analytical data layers.  You will own the systems that move behavioral event data from ingestion through transformation into our recommendation engine. You will design for correctness, build for observability, and make architectural tradeoffs with the pragmatism that only comes from production scars.  You will be an early engineering hire with real influence over our technical direction.  What You’ll Do   Design and operate high-throughput event ingestion pipelines capable of processing millions of events per day with low-latency serving requirements.  Own the dual-store architecture that separates our operational (real-time) and analytical (batch) data layers, including streaming vs. batch pipeline design and failure recovery.  Build and maintain data movement infrastructure between stores (Bigtable/Big Query or comparable), ensuring consistency, at-least-once delivery, and graceful degradation.  Instrument production systems: define SLOs, implement distributed tracing, and build alerting that distinguishes signal from noise.  Partner with the recommendation team to evolve our scoring, waterfall, and ranking infrastructure.  Drive architectural decisions on data modeling, schema evolution, and multi-tenant isolation.  Participate in an on-call rotation and own incidents end-to-end—from detection through root cause analysis to postmortem.    What We’re Looking For (Must-Haves)  5–10+ years of hands-on backend engineering in production environments (more is better).  Track record of building and operating high-performance, high-throughput, low-latency systems at scale—not just prototypes.  Deep working knowledge of Go’s concurrency model (goroutines, channels, context, sync primitives)—beyond syntax familiarity.  Experience with columnar or wide-column stores: Bigtable/Big Query strongly preferred; Cassandra, Dynamo DB, Redshift, or Snowflake are comparable.  Hands-on experience moving data between operational and analytical stores—you have solved streaming vs. batch tradeoffs, handled delivery guarantees, and recovered from pipeline failures.  Experience with production observability: metrics, tracing, alerting, dashboards—you know what good instrumentation looks like.  Multi-tenant Saa S experience—you understand isolation, scaling, and noisy-neighbor challenges when serving multiple customers on shared infrastructure.  Batch pipeline design experience—you know when batch is the right tool and how to make it reliable.  Dual-store architecture experience—you have operated systems where the operational and analytical data layers are intentionally separate.  Comfortable working daily in English with a US-based team (meetings, async communication, code reviews, and technical documentation).    Strong Nice-to-Haves   Identity resolution and cross-device stitching (probabilistic or deterministic).  A/B testing infrastructure built for statistical rigor—not just feature flags, but impression tracking, experiment analysis, and statistical significance frameworks.  Recommendation systems experience: scoring heuristics, waterfall algorithms, collaborative filtering, or hybrid approaches.  Ecommerce domain knowledge: attribution models, conversion tracking, order/cart data models, session stitching.    What We Offer   Compensation in the range of USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location, benchmarked to senior remote engineering roles in LATAM.  Remote-first culture with async-friendly practices.  Direct access to leadership; your architectural opinions will be heard and implemented.  A team that treats production reliability as a first-class engineering concern.    How to Apply   Please apply through Linked In with your CV (English) and a brief note highlighting:  Your experience with Go in production.  The most demanding data/throughput system you have owned.  Your country of residence and preferred start date.    You can also include links to Git Hub, technical blogs, or talks if available.

Principais responsabilidades:   Acompanhar e monitorar os principais indicadores (KPIs) relacionados à receita particular, apoiando análises de desempenho das unidades.  Apoiar visitas às unidades da regional, contribuindo para a identificação de oportunidades de melhoria e ações de relacionamento.  Dar suporte na execução e acompanhamento de iniciativas comerciais voltadas ao crescimento da receita particular.  Auxiliar no desenvolvimento e acompanhamento de planos de ação junto às unidades, com foco em engajamento e resultados.  Apoiar o cumprimento dos projetos e ações definidos para o negócio particular, garantindo alinhamento com as unidades operacionais.  Contribuir para a elaboração de reportes periódicos de desempenho, com análises de resultados e performance.  Participar de reuniões com áreas administrativas e operacionais, apoiando o alinhamento entre os times.  Atuar como apoio na disseminação da cultura de relacionamento e orientação para resultados nas unidades.  REQUIREMENTS AND QUALIFICATIONS    Para transformar a saúde é preciso:  Ensino Superior Completo;  Conhecimento intermediário em Pacote Office (análises de indicadores e apresentações);  Conhecimento em visitação e expansão de cultura será um diferencial;  Conhecimento em mudança de comportamento e gestão de vendas;  Conhecimento do mercado da saúde será um diferencial;  Disponibilidade para viagens.  ADDITIONAL INFORMATION    Local de trabalho:  Florianópolis - SC  É cuidando da nossa gente que vamos ser a saúde que as pessoas desejam e que o mundo precisa, confira os nossos benefícios:  · Cuidados com a alimentação: Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação ou Refeitório no local de trabalho (de acordo com a localidade);  · Cuidados com a saúde: Plano de Saúde e Seguro de Vida;  · Cuidados com o seu desenvolvimento: Universidade Dasa, Ciclo de Desenvolvimento e Carreira, Academias de Tecnologia/PMAX e Programa Crescer dentro da Dasa;  · Outros: Vale Transporte.  Só a Dasa tem – Programa de Saúde, pautado em 5 pilares:  · Espiritual: yoga;  · Físico: Total Pass, clínica de atenção primária, descontos em exames e vacinas;  · Intelectual: Universidade Dasa;  · Relacional: Clube de vantagens UAU e benefícios SESC;  · Emocional: Telepsicologia.  *Os benefícios podem sofrer alteração de acordo com a região da vaga e da marca.  Importante: Você está se candidatando para o nosso banco de talentos para vagas em todo o Brasil, nas localidades em que a Dasa possui operações (regiões Nordeste, Centro Oeste, Sudeste e Sul do Brasil), portanto, ressaltamos que assim que surgir uma vaga que melhor se adeque ao seu perfil, entraremos em contato com você. O combustível que você precisa   Para sustentar decisões que equilibram performance, competitividade e custo de pessoas - e garantir que nossa estratégia continue acelerando com consistência - buscamos alguém que traga:  Vivência sólida na área de Remuneração  , com domínio de estruturas e práticas de cargos e salários;  Experiência com metodologia Mercer  e utilização de pesquisas e banchmarks  de mercado;  Conhecimento em ferramentas de gestão orçamentária  ;  Domínio de legislação trabalhista aplicada ao negócio  ;  Pacote Office em nível avançado, especialmente Excel  para análises e modelagens;  Experiência com SAP (módulo financeiro e folha de pagamento)  .   Mais do que técnica, essa posição pede alguém que consiga transformar números em direcionamento estratégico para o negócio. Por isso, é importante que você tenha:  Forte capacidade analística e leitura crítica de dados;  Visão sistêmica e entendimento da relação entre estrutura, performance e sustentabilidade financeira;  Capacidade de influência e articulação para transitar com diferentes áreas e lideranças;  Organização e disciplina processual, garantindo governança e previsibilidade;  Uma pessoa com atitude de dona, com senso de respopnsabilidade e impacto nas decisões.   O que te coloca alguns quilômetros à frente   Se além de tudo isso você também tiver conhecimento em Power BI ou ferramentas similares de visualização e análise de dados  , seu impacto pode ser ainda maior.  Aqui, transformar dados em narrativas estratégicas faz diferença. A capacidade de estruturar dashboards  , traduzir indicadores de custo de pessoas em insights  acionáveis e apoiar decisões com visualizações claras potencializa muito a atuação da área e a influência junto à liderança. Licença Maternidade de 180 dias.  Wellhub.  Dayoff de Aniversário.  Reconhecimento de tempo de casa, entre outros.   Estamos prontos para conhecer você e a sua jornada. title: Supplier quality coordinator
description:
Confira a vaga para Supplier quality coordinator em taubaté. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, 80,000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.  Could you be the full-time Supplier Quality Coordinator in Taubaté we’re looking for?  Your future role   Take on a new challenge and apply your quality management expertise in a cutting-edge field. You’ll work alongside a collaborative and detail-oriented team of professionals.  You'll ensure the compliance of purchased products and parts delivered to Alstom facilities, making a significant impact on the quality and reliability of our operations. Day-to-day, you’ll work closely with teams across the business (procurement, engineering, and manufacturing), manage the Incoming Inspectors and Serial Supplier Quality Engineers, and oversee supplier quality performance, among other responsibilities.  You’ll specifically take care of incoming inspection management and supplier nonconformity management, but also contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and team development.  We’ll look to you for:  Collaborating with SPQD (Supplier Product and Quality Development) and Incoming Inspectors to ensure control plans are defined and registered in the ERP system   Ensuring inspection instructions and checklists are available and followed   Managing supplier nonconformities, including containment actions and root cause analysis   Leading and developing a team of SQ (Supplier Quality) engineers and inspectors   Preparing reports on supplier quality performance and improvement plans   Contributing to site quality continuous improvement programs   All about you   We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:  Bachelor’s degree in quality, engineering (mandatory)   Familiarity with supplier qualification standards (, ISO, ASME, IRIS, local standards)   Fluency in English, desireable Spanish   Experience managing supplier relationships and using SAP or similar systems   Knowledge of Quality Wall, Quality Basics, P-FMEA, and Control Plan management   Strong leadership and conflict management skills   Clear communication needed for the function  Analytical, detail-oriented, and process-focused mindset   Technical understanding in mechanical or electrical domains   Things you’ll enjoy   Join us on a life-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:  Enjoy stability, challenges, and a long-term career free from monotonous daily routines   Collaborate with transverse teams and helpful colleagues   Contribute to innovative projects that redefine mobility   Utilise our flexible and inclusive working environment   Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries   Benefit from our investment in your development through award-winning learning programs   Progress towards leadership roles or technical specialisations   Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward package that recognises your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage (life, medical, pension)   You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!  Important to note   As a global business, we’re an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

JOB DESCRIPTION    A Movida é uma empresa de soluções inovadoras em mobilidade urbana e modelo de negócios com forte direcionamento para desenvolvimento socioambiental. Desde 2006 no mercado, conta hoje com a frota mais nova do Brasil e dispõe de lojas nas principais cidades e aeroportos do país. A companhia é reconhecida como uma locadora moderna, alinhada às últimas tendências tecnológicas e que investe em diversificação e renovação de frota, treinamento de funcionários e serviços exclusivos.  Norteada pela devoção em servir, foi pioneira em oferecer serviços como aluguel mensal e de longo prazo para pessoa física, opções para pré-pagamento e diárias de 27 horas. Focada em tecnologia, também saiu na frente do setor ao oferecer soluções como web check-in, wi-fi no carro, chatbot nas redes sociais e tecnologia de pagamento contactless em todos os veículos.  Empresa da SIMPAR, hoje faz parte da Movida Participações, criada em 2015 para administrar as operações de Aluguel de Carros, Venda de Seminovos e de Gestão de Terceirização de Frotas de veículos leves.  Com mais de 6000 colaboradores apaixonados, a Movida se diferencia pelo seu "jeitão" inovador e descomplicado. Carrega em seu DNA o foco no cliente e a sua GENTE como prioridade!  Todos os processos seletivos conduzidos pela MOVIDA   são afirmativos, inclusivos e não discriminatórios.  RESPONSIBILITIES AND ASSIGNMENTS    Análise e regulação de ordens de serviço de manutenção de veículos da frota.  REQUIREMENTS AND QUALIFICATIONS    Ensino Médio completo  Pacote Office  ADDITIONAL INFORMATION    Os benefícios tradicionais que você já conhece, nós também temos. Queremos te mostrar que vamos além. Saiba mais!  LIGADO EM VOCÊ:   Atendimento especializado para a nossa gente e familiares por meio de uma central 24 horas para apoio psicológico, sobre saúde, social, familiar, financeiro e/ou jurídico e tudo isso com sigilo absoluto.  Licença Maternidade   e Paternidade estendidas   + Kit nascimento   para recém-mamães e recém-papais.  Sabemos o quanto a educação das crianças e adolescentes é importante. Aqui na MOVIDA  , damos aquela ajuda na compra do kit escolar   para os filhos da nossa gente.  Nossa gente tem acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma de descontos   em viagens, cultura e entretenimento, serviços, gastronomia, educação e bem-estar.  Pela Universidade MOVIDA  , a nossa gente aprende e potencializa seu desenvolvimento profissional, tornando cada um(a) protagonista de sua carreira.  Reconhecemos e valorizamos a nossa gente veterana   que completa anos de casa. Quem possui mais de 15 anos  , ainda tem um evento mega especial.  Cantinho da Mamãe:   O espaço, na Matriz no Itaim Bibi e Sede Administrativa em Mogi das Cruzes, é dedicado as mamães que retornam de licença maternidade e querem seguir com o aleitamento materno.   No local, há todos os itens para retirar e armazenar o leite, com privacidade e conforto.   Totalpass:  Acesso a uma ampla rede de academias e serviços de saúde mental e nutrição, promovendo hábitos saudáveis e bem-estar.  Se identificou com essa vaga? Conheça as nossas vagas, inscreva-se e vamos juntos participar dessa Empresa que cresce todos os dias.  SOBRE A MOVIDA    Sobre Movida   A Movida (MOVI3) é uma empresa de aluguel de carros que oferece soluções inovadoras em mobilidade urbana para todo tipo de necessidade. Pioneira em oferecer serviços como aluguel mensal para pessoa física, Wi-Fi no carro, pré-pagamento e Chat Bot nas redes sociais, foi a primeira locadora do país a ir além do carro, ajudando a revolucionar o setor de locação no Brasil. Antenada aos novos tempos, investe em sustentabilidade, sendo a primeira locadora de veículos no mundo, listada em bolsa, a receber a Certificação de Empresa B, fazendo parte de um seleto grupo de companhias que têm como modelo de negócios o desenvolvimento socioambiental. No Brasil, foi a primeira a ter um programa como o Carbon Free, que neutraliza as emissões de CO2 das locações dos seus clientes.  Desde 2006 no mercado, a Movida foi adquirida em 2013 pela JSL, abriu capital em fevereiro de 2017 e hoje é uma das empresas da SIMPAR S. A. Com perfil inovador aliado a forte governança corporativa, atua tanto no varejo, com aluguel de carros, como no mercado corporativo, com a terceirização de frotas para empresas, além da venda de seminovos. Após diversos investimentos nos últimos quatro anos, conta com uma frota de mais de 268 mil veículos, 259 lojas de aluguel de carros e 89 pontos de venda de seminovos. Otimizar o programa de confiabilidade de ativos no parque industrial da unidade, através da análise dos planos e programas de manutenção existentes, estudo do histórico dos equipamentos, implementando os pilares do programa, a fim de atingir as metas estabelecidas. Participar da elaboração do plano de manutenção preventiva, preditiva e corretiva programada, analisando o histórico de intervenções e as requisições de serviços da área, o manual do fabricante de cada equipamento, o histórico de produção e indicadores do programa, identificando desvios e propondo melhorias, com o objetivo de aperfeiçoar as intervenções e fazer cumprir o programa de confiabilidade dos equipamentos.  Estabelecer e manter atualizadas as especificações dos equipamentos, através do levantamento de todos os componentes dos ativos, estudo de criticidade, implementação de boas práticas de lubrificação, FMEA, RCA e MCA, análise de modo e efeito de falha, a fim de propor melhorias nas intervenções e gerar indicadores de desempenho de planejamento e manutenção.  Participar ativamente da reunião semanal de programação, visando assegurar o cumprimento do workflow nos serviços que serão programados.  Acompanhar a programação semanal de manutenção, analisando os feedbacks realizados, cumprimento do programado, encerramento das OS’s, etc.  Assegurar o cumprimento do workflow, reorientando a equipe em caso de falhas no processo.  Avaliar a qualidade dos relatórios das manutenções, avaliando as análises, coerência dos alarmes encontrados, medições dos ativos e buscando soluções.  Monitorar as paradas não programadas de equipamentos chave para o processo, analisar causas e propor ações para evitar reincidências.  Monitorar e realizar análise de tendências de todos os dados de PDM (Manutenção Preditiva), PM (Manutenção Preventiva) visando traçar ações proativas garantindo a confiabilidade dos equipamentos.  Contribuir com o tratamento das ocorrências levantadas nos Relatos de Anomalias, verificando se as falhas encontradas podem ter sido causadas por falta de manutenção e buscando evitar reincidência.  Acompanhar e contribuir com as atividades do Planejador e Programador de manutenção.  Manter atualizados os sistemas de PM (Manutenção Preventiva) e PDM (Manutenção Preditiva) e CMMS (Sistema de Gestão de Manutenção).  Elaborar o projeto de construção do setor de boas práticas de Lubrificação, seguindo normas padrão ISO/NAS, organizando treinamento externo, planejamento e acompanhamento dos custos, para garantir a difusão do conhecimento das normas entre os membros da equipe e manter a qualidade do processo de lubrificação dentro dos padrões do programa. Esse time é o nosso Centro de Excelência em IA  , responsável por definir padrões, boas práticas, governança e a evolução técnica das soluções.Nesta posição, você atuará de forma embedada  em uma das verticais estratégicas da área de Experiência (Cadastro, Suporte, Customer Success e Qualidade, trabalhando lado a lado com a operação, ao mesmo tempo em que mantém alinhamento técnico com o time de AI Experts. O que é essencial você trazer?    Curiosidade e interesse genuíno por IA aplicada ao negócio.  ●      Gosto por ensinar, orientar e compartilhar conhecimento  , ajudando outras pessoas a evoluírem no uso de tecnologia.  ●      Facilidade para aprender, testar e adaptar novas ferramentas.  ●      Capacidade de explicar conceitos técnicos de forma simples para pessoas não técnicas.  ●      Autonomia para atuar no dia a dia, sabendo quando escalar dúvidas ou decisões.  ●      Orientação a resultados e melhoria contínua.  ●      Experiência prática com automação de processos  e orquestração de fluxos.  ●      Vivência no consumo e integração de APIs REST  .  ●      Conforto para lidar com ferramentas técnicas, fluxos, parâmetros e autenticação.  ●      Familiaridade com Git Hub  para versionamento e documentação.  ●      Vivência com ferramentas de gestão ágil, como Jira  .  ●      Interesse e contato prévio com IA Generativa via API  aplicada a workflows.  ●      Disponibilidade de atuação no modelo híbrido em Florianópolis/SC. Você fará brilhar nossos olhos se tiver:   Experiência prévia com n8n  .  ●      Vivência com plataformas de atendimento, comunicação ou CRM (Hub Spot, Zendesk, BLIP, Pipefy, entre outras).  ●      Experiência atuando próximo a times operacionais ou áreas de negócio.  ●      Interesse em métricas de eficiência e mensuração de impacto das automações. Benefícios de fazer parte do Condo Conta:    Contratação que facilita sua autonomia financeira;  Reembolso por dias presenciais (para quem está no modelo híbrido em Florianópolis);  Equipamentos para trabalhar com conforto;  Gympass e Conexa Saúde para cuidar do corpo e da mente;  Auxílio home office;  Day off no aniversário e por tempo de empresa;  …e outros benefícios para apoiar sua jornada dentro e fora do trabalho.   Aqui você encontra propósito, inovação e espaço para crescer.  Vem sem um Condo Power  e construir o futuro da vida condominial com a gente!

Se você respondeu sim às perguntas acima, por favor, continue lendo!Escala 3x2 (6h-18h ou 18h-5h). As pessoas precisam ter a flexibilidade em atuar aos finais de semanas e feriados. A Amazon está comprometida com um ambiente de trabalho diverso e inclusivo. A Amazon é um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades e não discrimina com base em raça, origem nacional, gênero, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, status de veterano protegido, deficiência, idade ou outro status legalmente protegido.Key job responsibilitiesO cargo de Flow Lead - Central Flow tem como responsabilidades principais: • Ser um especialista em Outbound e Flow, sendo o ponto de contato para a operação responsável;• Entender como os sistemas da Amazon se conectam e impactos;• Executar e desenvolver planos para o turno baseado nos requisitos operacionais e ajustar conforme as variáveis mudam;• Atuar como dono do processo de planejamento para 1 ou 2 FCs simultâneos, insistindo nos mais altos padrões;• Suportar a operação em melhoria de fluxo;• Gerenciar o fluxo dos pedidos por múltiplos processos;• Ser responsável pela comunicação com os gerentes de operações e pelo escalonamento de qualquer risco a experiência do cliente ou falha;• Atuar como consultor das operações com base em sua visão holística do flow;• Facilitar a comunicação entre as múltiplas áreas da operação;• Analisar e tomar decisões com base em dados;• Auditar a operação de acordo com o planejamento;• Entender a relação entre as responsabilidades da operação e do flow, de acordo com os procedimentos padronizados estabelecidos pela gestão do fluxo de processos;• Responsável pelo resultado alcançado (fluxo, risco e perdas) e analise em caso de falha.
